data.desc: Lithium Argentina jointly owns and manages the Cauchari-Olaroz lithium brine operation in the Jujuy province of Argentina and is advancing the PPG lithium brine development in the Salta province of Argentina. Lithium is a key material used in the production of lithium-ion batteries, electric vehicles, and battery energy storage systems (BESS). The Company currently trades on the TSX and on the NYSE under the ticker 'LAR'.
